convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iATR, iMA). Entry/exit rules are straightforward combinations of ATRStops and StepUpDown. Position sizing is fixed or risk-percentage based. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic (only standard Trade/SymbolInfo/PositionInfo/AccountInfo). No grid, martingale, or pending order complexity.

derived_values.name: pip - digit-adjusted point value
derived_values.formula: _Point*10 when _Digits==3||5 or symbol starts with 'X'||'#', else _Point

derived_values.name: atrpos - ATR direction state
derived_values.formula: atrpos[br]=+1 if CLOSE[br]>smax[br+1], -1 if CLOSE[br]<smin[br+1], else previous

derived_values.name: sideup/sidedn - trailing ATR stop levels
derived_values.formula: sideup=smin when atrpos>0 (ratchet up), sidedn=smax when atrpos<0 (ratchet down)

derived_values.name: StepUpDown trend direction
derived_values.formula: Based on MAHi/MALo over last 10 bars of Fast SMA and divergence of Fast SMA vs Slow SMMA

derived_values.name: SLTP distance (CalculateSLTP)
derived_values.used_by: OpenPosition stop loss and take profit

other_exits: CloseOrderProfit: closes buy when StepUpDown turns down and position is profitable; closes sell when StepUpDown turns up and position is profitable (only when trailing stop is disabled)
Hour-based cooldown: no new entry if last close hour equals current hour (HR_CLOSE!=HR check)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MoneyManagementType=DynamicLotSize(1): lots = (balance*risk_pct/100)/(contract_size/leverage), normalized by volume step, clamped to min/max. When MoneyManagementType=FixedLot(0): uses TradeLotSize input (0.1).

custom_logic_notes: EA runs on 60-second timer, not on tick. Trade logic checks minute change (cmnt!=pmnt) as new-bar guard. ATRStops signal: buy when sidedn[1]>0 && sidedn[0]==0 && sideup[0]>0 (flip from down to up); sell when sideup[1]>0 && sideup[0]==0 && sidedn[0]>0 (flip from up to down). StepUpDown signal: based on whether MAHi index > MALo index over lookback of 10 bars on Fast SMA, combined with divergence of Fast SMA minus Slow SMMA. Both must agree (tfx=1 for buy, tfx=-1 for sell). Entry blocked if last deal closed in same hour. Signal reversal closes opposite position when CloseByOppositeSignal=Yes. CloseOrderProfit provides a non-trailing profit exit based on StepUpDown reversal when position is in profit. SL minimum enforced at 38*pip.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Timer-based (60s) execution must be converted to on-bar (H1) logic since Python backtesting engines typically operate bar-by-bar. 2) ATRStops indicator is computed inline (not a standard library indicator) - must be reimplemented as a custom function computing smin/smax/sideup/sidedn arrays with ratchet logic. 3) StepUpDown is also custom logic using Fast SMA vs Slow SMMA divergence - must reimplement the MAHi/MALo/divergence logic. 4) The pip digit-adjustment logic (x10 for 5-digit brokers, XAU, etc.) must be handled in SL/TP calculation. 5) CalculateSLTP uses moneyrisk/(lots*tickvaluesize)/leveragerisk which is non-standard; the minimum 38-pip floor must be preserved. 6) CloseOrderProfit exit (StepUpDown reversal + positive profit) is an additional exit path beyond SL/TP/trailing that must be implemented. 7) Hour-cooldown gate (no re-entry in same hour as last close) must be tracked. 8) ModifySLTP trailing stop uses freeze_level+5 safety margin - must check symbol freeze level. 9) CTrade/CSymbolInfo/CPositionInfo/CAccountInfo standard library calls map to direct broker API calls in Python.
